description.en: MGEX 1/100 Unicorn Gundam Ver. Ka [Premium “Unicorn Mode” Box] is now available!

description.ja: 通常版と異なる“ユニコーンモード”を主体としたボックスアートでお届け！
description.en: Delivered with box art featuring a “unicorn mode” that is different from the regular version!

description.ja: • 　アイテム情報
description.en: • Item information

description.ja: ●　極限の“発光機構”
description.en: ● Extreme “light-emitting mechanism”

description.ja: 新規開発の”フレキシブルLEDシート”により、変身、発光、色調変化、可動すべての共立を実現。
description.en: The newly developed "flexible LED sheet" realizes transformation, light emission, color change, and movement.

description.ja: ・ユニコーンモード、デストロイモードの変身を再現可能。
description.en: - Unicorn mode and Destroy mode transformations can be reproduced.

description.ja: ・赤色の発光から緑色の発光への色調変化を表現可能。
description.en: ・It is possible to express a change in color tone from red light emission to green light emission.

description.ja: ・シールド単独ディスプレイ時も専用ディスプレイスタンドにより発光。
description.en: ・Even when Seal is displayed alone, it emits light using a dedicated display stand.

description.ja: ・新設計された変身機構は、直感的かつスムーズな変身を可能に。
description.en: - The newly designed transformation mechanism enables intuitive and smooth transformation.

description.ja: ・向上した膝可動、肩の引き出しギミックなど、各所の設計を見直し、広い可動域を確保。
description.en: ・We have reviewed the design of various parts, such as improved knee movement and shoulder pull-out gimmick, to ensure a wide range of motion.

description.ja: ●　カトキハジメ氏完全監修
description.en: ● Fully supervised by Hajime Katoki

description.ja: 氏の完全監修のもと、全身の設計・デザインを再構築し、新規造形で製作。
description.en: Under his complete supervision, the entire body was redesigned and produced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属！
description.en: ● Newly designed water transfer decal included!

description.ja: カトキハジメ氏デザインのマーキングが水転写式デカールで付属。
description.en: Marking designed by Hajime Katoki is included as a water transfer decal.

description.ja: ●　専用ＭＳ ＣＡＧＥがセット
description.en: ● Dedicated MS CAGE is included

description.ja: 電飾ユニットの電池ＢＯＸを格納した専用のＭＳ ＣＡＧＥが付属。ディスプレイ用支柱の位置調整、武器の保持が可能。
description.en: Comes with a dedicated MS CAGE that stores the battery box for the illumination unit. It is possible to adjust the position of the display support and hold weapons.

description.ja: また、リード線を使用することで、シールドファンネルの発光演出も可能。
description.en: In addition, by using the lead wire, it is possible to create a luminous effect of the sealed funnel.

description.ja: ●　通常版と異なる“ユニコーンモード”を主体としたボックスアートでお届け。
description.en: ● Delivered with box art featuring a “unicorn mode” that is different from the regular version.

description.en: Attached weapons: Beam Magnum / Beam Saber / Seal / Beam Gatling Gun / Hyper Bazooka
